title: Contract catalogue and code generation
claim_boundary: Source implementation is compiler-backed for contract invariants and nine explicitly Rust-owned schema roots. All 60 canonical schemas/examples and exact digests are statically checked, but generated/canonical constraint losses, downstream consumers and Track 35 bindings remain separate evidence gates.

assertions.statement: Validate all JSON Schemas and examples
open_gates: Resolve the explicit generated/canonical constraint losses before claiming exact semantic parity.
assertions.permitted_claim: All 60 checked-in JSON Schemas and examples are statically validated; nine explicitly Rust-owned roots have compiler-backed root-field parity, with exact constraint parity denied.

assertions.statement: Generate schemas from Rust types and diff against checked-in canonical forms
open_gates: Resolve additional-properties, uniqueness, constant, range and string-length losses before claiming exact semantic equality.
assertions.permitted_claim: Nine neutral-core root schemas are generated from compiled Rust types and structurally diffed against canonical forms; the machine-readable loss report denies exact semantic parity.

assertions.statement: Add compatibility fixtures and migration/version rules
open_gates: Add semantic compatibility fixtures and migration tests before a stable release.
assertions.permitted_claim: Exact schema, WIT, OpenAPI and MCP surface drift is gated; semantic compatibility remains separate.

assertions.statement: Add report/study linkage and protocol-amendment contracts
assertions.permitted_claim: Report/study linkage and protocol-amendment invariants are compiler-tested, including duplicate report references within a study, duplicate amendment paths and transactional attachment failure.

assertions.statement: Define the thin-binding generation contract and delegate executable TypeScript/Python generation to Track 35 / SR-086
open_gates: Generate, compile and install-smoke thin TypeScript/Python packages under Track 35 / SR-086 after the neutral schema surface stabilises.
assertions.permitted_claim: Thin-binding ownership, package identities and no-domain-logic policy are explicit; executable binding generation remains delegated to Track 35 and is not claimed here.

open_gates: Populate compiler, exact round-trip and downstream-consumer results only from matching receipts.
assertions.permitted_claim: The generated 60-contract matrix records static validation and exact canonical digests, with compiler, round-trip and downstream columns fail-closed as not evidenced.
